Mere disagreement does not make a source false. Fill all opaque keys.

A passage saying candidate X is the artist, born date, sport, population or symbol asked for is SUPPORT, never counterevidence merely because another passage gives Y. Set support to that passage, fit=direct, observed_slot to the requested role, and counter empty unless there is actual negation or role exclusion. A player practicing golf AND tennis supports BOTH sports. A passage saying London is a birthplace makes London a wrong_argument for a birth-DATE question.
